newsitem.title: UK: Halifax made 25 mln stg provision in July.
newsitem.headline: Halifax made 25 mln stg provision in July.

text.p: The Halifax Building Society said on Wednesday it had made a 25.0 million stg exceptional provision during July for costs related to its branch network rationalisation programme.
The building society said the provision was the only significant feature to report in a financial information report for the six months to July 31.
It had already reported its interim results to June 30 on August 20 but had to make the new announcement due to a change in its year-end date from January 31 to December 31.
It said there were no material recognised gains or losses other than the profit for the six months to July 31, 1996, six months to January 31 1996 or six months to July 31, 1995.
Pre-tax profit for the six months to July 31, 1996 was 707.2 million stg, compared with 516.7 million stg for the same period the year before.
Provisions for bad and doubtful debts were 52.2 million stg, compared with 49.1 million stg at the end of January 1996 and 37 million stg at the end of July 1995.
